local FX = _G.FX
local CWelfarePreview = FX.Class("CWelfarePreview", "CWelfareUI")

-- 初始化可替换的本地模拟数据。
-- @param owner table 编辑器组件宿主
function CWelfarePreview:Ctor(owner)
    CWelfarePreview.Super.Ctor(self, owner)
    self.State = {
        tab = 1,
        closed = false,
        onlineMinutes = 12,
        onlineClaimed = {},
        signInDay = 1,
        signed = false,
        tasks = {
            {value = 1000, target = 1000, claimed = false},
            {value = 1, target = 3, claimed = false},
            {value = 0, target = 1, claimed = false}
        }
    }
end

-- 返回展示用模拟状态。
-- @return table 模拟数据
function CWelfarePreview:GetUIState()
    return self.State
end

-- 接入完成后刷新首帧。
function CWelfarePreview:BindUIData()
    self:RefreshUI()
end

-- 处理本地模拟领取；真实业务需独立校验与发奖。
-- @param action string 稳定动作名称
-- @param payload table 页签或奖励业务 ID
function CWelfarePreview:OnUIAction(action, payload)
    local state = self.State
    if action == "SelectTab" then
        state.tab = payload.tabId
    elseif action == "Close" then
        state.closed = true
    elseif action == "Claim" then
        local index = payload.rewardId
        if payload.kind == "online" then
            local minutes = {5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60}
            if state.onlineMinutes >= minutes[index] and not state.onlineClaimed[index] then
                state.onlineClaimed[index] = true
            end
        elseif payload.kind == "signin" then
            if index == state.signInDay and not state.signed then
                state.signed = true
            end
        elseif payload.kind == "task" then
            local item = state.tasks[index]
            if item.value >= item.target and not item.claimed then
                item.claimed = true
            end
        end
    end
    self:RefreshUI()
end

return CWelfarePreview

local FX = _G.FX
local Loader = FX.Loader
local CWelfareUI = FX.Class("CWelfareUI", "CUIEditorUICompClass")

-- 绑定页签、领取与关闭；所有动作携带稳定业务 ID。
function CWelfareUI:OnReady()
    self.Root = Loader:PlayerGui("WelfareUI")
    local tabs = {"OnlineTabBtn", "SignInTabBtn", "TasksTabBtn"}
    for index, name in ipairs(tabs) do
        self:TrackConnection(Loader:Here(self.Root, "TabsBox." .. name).Activated:Connect(function()
            self:EmitUIAction("SelectTab", {tabId = index})
        end))
    end
    local groups = {{"OnlineBox", "Reward", 6, "online"}, {"SignInBox", "Day", 7, "signin"}, {"TasksBox", "Task", 3, "task"}}
    for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
        for index = 1, group[3] do
            local button = Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg." .. group[1] .. "." .. group[2] .. index .. "Img.ClaimBtn")
            self:TrackConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
                self:EmitUIAction("Claim", {kind = group[4], rewardId = index})
            end))
        end
    end
    self:TrackConnection(Loader:Here(self.Root, "TitleBox.CloseSurfaceImg.CloseBtn").Activated:Connect(function()
        self:EmitUIAction("Close", {})
    end))
end

-- 更新一个领取按钮。
-- @param path string 相对根节点的路径
-- @param label string 状态文案
-- @param enabled boolean 是否允许点击
function CWelfareUI:RenderButton(path, label, enabled)
    local button = Loader:Here(self.Root, path)
    self:SetButtonEnabled(button, enabled)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(103, 237, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(99, 128, 121)
    Loader:Here(button, "ButtonTxt").Text = label
    Loader:Here(button, "BottomEdgeImg").BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(34, 90, 7) or Color3.fromRGB(38, 62, 54)
end

-- 依据接入数据展示各页，设计节点保持可编辑。
-- @param state table 页签、在线分钟、签到与任务状态
function CWelfareUI:Render(state)
    self.Root.Enabled = not state.closed
    local pages = {"OnlineBox", "SignInBox", "TasksBox"}
    local tabs = {"OnlineTabBtn", "SignInTabBtn", "TasksTabBtn"}
    for index, name in ipairs(pages) do
        Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg." .. name).Visible = state.tab == index
        local labels = {"Online\nRewards", "Daily Login", "Tasks"}
        self:RenderButton("TabsBox." .. tabs[index], labels[index], true)
        local button = Loader:Here(self.Root, "TabsBox." .. tabs[index])
        if state.tab ~= index then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(99, 128, 121)
            Loader:Here(button, "BottomEdgeImg").BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 62, 54)
        end
    end
    local minutes = {5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60}
    Loader:Here(self.Root, "PopupPanelImg.OnlineBox.SubtitleTxt").Text = "Online: " .. state.onlineMinutes .. " min · Resets daily"
    for index, target in ipairs(minutes) do
        local claimed = state.onlineClaimed[index]
        local enabled = state.onlineMinutes >= target and not claimed
        local label = claimed and "Claimed" or (enabled and "Claim" or "Locked")
        self:RenderButton("PopupPanelImg.OnlineBox.Reward" .. index .. "Img.ClaimBtn", label, enabled)
    end
    for index = 1, 7 do
        local enabled = index == state.signInDay and not state.signed
        local label = enabled and "Check In" or (index == state.signInDay and state.signed and "Checked In" or (index == state.signInDay + 1 and "Tomorrow" or "Locked"))
        self:RenderButton("PopupPanelImg.SignInBox.Day" .. index .. "Img.ClaimBtn", label, enabled)
    end
    for index, item in ipairs(state.tasks) do
        local path = "PopupPanelImg.TasksBox.Task" .. index .. "Img"
        local bar = Loader:Here(self.Root, path .. ".ProgressBarImg")
        Loader:Here(bar, "ProgressFillImg").Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(item.value / item.target, 1), 1)
        Loader:Here(bar, "ProgressTxt").Text = item.value .. " / " .. item.target
        local enabled = item.value >= item.target and not item.claimed
        self:RenderButton(path .. ".ClaimBtn", item.claimed and "Claimed" or (enabled and "Claim" or "In Progress"), enabled)
    end
end

return CWelfareUI
